**This repository does not accept pull requests.**

It is maintained by one person on a best-effort basis, and pull requests are
closed without review. That is about capacity, not about your work.

If this fixes a bug or adds something useful, please open an
[issue](https://github.com/mellicci/agent-tokenwatch/issues/new/choose)
describing it instead. A good idea may be implemented independently and credited
in the changelog. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mellicci/agent-tokenwatch/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
